posts.text:
Your key should not be the only thing protecting your Bitcoin.

A Flagship Vault is a multisig held across you and AnchorWatch. Neither side can move your Bitcoin without the other.

Recovery is defined in the vault through on-chain rules, not a document you hope someone finds.
